title: Synergistic regulation of crystallization and the buried interface in CsxFA1−xPbI3 perovskite photovoltaics using a multifunctional sulfonyl–ammonium additive
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2606-2615
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07806G, Paper
Sanwan Liu, Yifei Xu, Tianyin Miao, Qian Liu, Likai Zheng, Rui Chen, Jianan Wang, He Zhu, Zhengtian Tan, Ziming Yin, Yan Zhao, Wei Chen, Michael Grätzel, Zonghao Liu
A multifunctional AEMS additive synergistically regulates the crystallization and buried interface of inverted CsxFA1−xPbI3 perovskite solar cells, yielding a certified efficiency of 26.80% and robust long-term operational stability.
